AcceptanceTest is the only test class and it passes, along with the full build.

Done. The change rejects creating an owner whose lower-cased email is already used by another owner, responding 409.

**What I added:**
- `RequireUniqueEmail` (function) — after email normalization, scans existing owners and throws `DuplicateEmailException` when the request's lower-cased email matches any existing owner's (normalized) email. An absent/blank email passes through, since email is optional.
- `DuplicateEmailException` (checked exception) + `DuplicateEmailExceptionHandler` — responds `409 CONFLICT` with a `ProblemDetail`, mirroring the existing duplicate-telephone handling.
- Escalation YAML mapping the exception to its handler.
- Wired `requireUniqueEmail` into `owners.POST.yml` right after `normalizeEmail` (so the comparison uses the canonical lower-cased value) and before `requireUniqueTelephone`, under the same transaction governance.

This reuses the existing `OwnerEmails.normalize(...)` helper for canonicalization and follows the same single-responsibility, one-step-per-class pattern as the sibling `RequireUniqueTelephone`/`RequireUniqueHousehold` functions rather than adding logic to an existing class. Full test suite is green.
